test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid hemisphere of radius 12 cm is melted into N identical cones, each of radius 6 cm and height 8 cm. What is the value of N?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of hemisphere (r₁) = 12 cm

Radius of cone (r₂) = 6 cm

Height of cone (h) = 8 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3)πr₁³

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr₂²h

Number of cones (N) = Volume of hemisphere ÷ Volume of one cone
